All candidates verified at source. I have six currently-open opportunities that clear the currency gate, plus several that failed it. Here's the producer output.

Educational note before the JSON (kept out of the machine-read payload): the hardest part of this run was the **currency gate**, not discovery. Search snippets carried stale round numbers (Stellar SCF #43 with an April 2026 deadline that had already passed); only a source fetch revealed the live round is **SCF #45 (deadline 2026-07-26)**. Cardano Catalyst Fund 15 looked promising in search but its source showed funding milestones already underway with no confirmable open submission window — so it's rejected, not emitted. That gap between "exists in search" and "open right now at the canonical URL" is exactly what WebFetch verification closes.
